_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Yemen covering ancient Saba (Sheba, Queen of Sheba), Himyarite kingdom, Marib Dam, frankincense/myrrh trade, Islamic conquest 630s, Zaidi imamate, Ottoman rule (north), Aden British colony (south, 1839-1967), North Yemen Arab Republic 1962 (revolution vs imamate), South Yemen Marxist (PDRY), unification 1990, civil war 1994, Ali Abdullah Saleh's 33-year rule, Arab Spring 2011, Houthi insurgency, Saudi-led intervention 2015, humanitarian catastrophe, and ongoing civil war (Houthis vs Saudi-backed government).

country_profile.government_type: Unitary presidential republic (de jure); effectively divided between Houthi-controlled north (Sana'a) and internationally recognized government (Aden/Riyadh-based) since 2014

population.source: UN estimate (census impossible due to war)

religion.note: Sunni Shafi'i majority in south/coast; Zaidi Shia (moderate branch) in northern highlands (Sa'dah, Houthi base); sectarian civil war dimension (Zaidi Houthis vs Sunni government, but also political/tribal); historically tolerant; Yemeni Jews (~50 remain, once ~50,000)

ethnic_groups.name: Arab (Yemeni)
ethnic_groups.notes: Majority; Qahtanite (southern Arab) ancestry; tribal society (qabilah); highland vs coastal (Tihama) divide; north (Zaidi) vs south (Sunni) historical split; armed tribesmen; qat chewing; khanjar dagger

ethnic_groups.name: Afro-Arab (Akhdam/Muhamasheen)
ethnic_groups.notes: 'Servants'/'Marginalized Ones'; African ancestry; lowest social class; street sweepers; untouchable-like status; ~3.5M; severe discrimination

ethnic_groups.name: South Asian
ethnic_groups.notes: Migrant workers; declining due to war

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Somali, Yemeni Jews, etc.)
ethnic_groups.notes: Somali refugees; Yemeni Jews nearly extinct (Operation Magic Carpet 1949-50 to Israel, ~50 remain); small European/Asian

independence.from: North Yemen and South Yemen merged 1990

country_profile.notes_unique: World's worst humanitarian crisis (UN); civil war 2014-present (~400,000 dead including famine/disease); Houthis (Ansar Allah, Zaidi, Iranian-backed) seized Sana'a 2014; Saudi-led coalition 2015+ (UAE pulled back 2019); famine; cholera epidemic; Bab-el-Mandeb (strategic strait); Al-Qaeda presence (AQAP); Marib Dam (ancient engineering marvel); Sana'a Old City (UNESCO, bombed); Socotra island (unique biodiversity); qat (mild stimulant, afternoon chew, 40% water usage); poorest Arab country

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.

current_government_leader.name: Rashad al-Alimi
current_government_leader.title: Chairman of Presidential Leadership Council
current_government_leader.notes: Saudi-backed; replaced Hadi; leads 8-member council; based in Aden/Riyadh; internationally recognized but limited control; fractious coalition

houthi_leader.name: Abdul-Malik al-Houthi
houthi_leader.title: Leader of Ansar Allah (Houthi movement)
houthi_leader.notes: Zaidi; controls Sana'a and northern Yemen (~70% population); Iranian-backed (weapons, advisors); 'Death to America, Death to Israel' slogan; attacked Saudi Arabia/UAE; Red Sea shipping attacks 2023-24; brother Hussein al-Houthi (founder, killed 2004)

former_leaders.name: Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi
former_leaders.notes: President; succeeded Saleh; Arab Spring transition; Houthis drove him out 2015; fled to Saudi Arabia; resigned 2022; ineffective; replaced by council

former_leaders.name: Ali Abdullah Saleh
former_leaders.notes: North Yemen President 1978-90, unified Yemen President 1990-2012; 33-year rule; master manipulator ('dancing on heads of snakes'); Arab Spring protests 2011 (ousted); allied with Houthis 2014; switched sides 2017 (killed by Houthis December 2017, Sana'a); corruption; tribes

former_leaders.name: Ali Nasir Muhammad
former_leaders.notes: South Yemen (PDRY) President; Marxist; 1986 civil war (fled); 13-day war

former_leaders.name: Ibrahim al-Hamdi
former_leaders.notes: North Yemen; reformist military ruler; assassinated 1977 (mystery, Saleh took power 1978)

former_leaders.name: Abdullah al-Sallal
former_leaders.notes: North Yemen Arab Republic first president; overthrew Imam; Egyptian-backed; ousted

former_leaders.name: Muhammad al-Badr
former_leaders.notes: Last Zaidi Imam; overthrown 1962 revolution; fled; died in exile (UK)

former_leaders.name: Imam Ahmad bin Yahya
former_leaders.notes: Zaidi Imamate; reactionary; isolated Yemen; son al-Badr succeeded briefly
